storage.filesystem_block_inode_quota: fresh effective checks before future pilot
storage.temp_scope: future exclusive output/temp only; TMPDIR MPLCONFIGDIR XDG_CACHE_HOME bound there after approval
storage.block_estimate: 2GiB covers 512MiB final + 512MiB pending + 512MiB temporary + 32MiB log + 64MiB journal + 1MiB terminal; 4KiB block padding and 20000 fresh inodes reserve
storage.quota: default guard STOP if quota enabled; no configured provider; fresh mount/quota effective evidence required
storage.temporary_limit_semantics: 512MiB is an admission reservation, not an independently enforced temp-directory byte cap; namespace must be under exclusive output and effective filesystem reserve is checked by monitor

carry.known_held_failed_unknown_policy: bind original history/ledger before approval; null is UNKNOWN, never zero
